ticket.title: Export invoices as CSV
ticket.body:
## Why

Finance copies invoices into a spreadsheet by hand at the end of every month.

## What

- Add an "Export" button to the invoice list.
- The file should contain the invoices with their amounts.
- People should be able to open it in Excel.

## Notes

This ticket is sample data for the web app's mocks and the server's smoke test. It has nothing to do with the demo repo.

assumptions.text: Should the file contain every invoice, or only the ones matching the filters on screen?
readings: Export every invoice in the workspace.
Export only the invoices that match the filters currently applied to the list.
assumptions.answer: Only what matches the current filters.

assumptions.text: Should voided invoices be in the file?
readings: Include voided invoices, with a status column.
assumptions.answer: Include them, with their status, so finance can reconcile.

assumptions.text: Who may export: everyone who can open the invoice list, or only admins and finance?
readings: Anyone who can see the invoice list can export it.
Only the admin and finance roles can export.
assumptions.answer: Anyone who can see the list can export it, since the file shows nothing the list does not.

assumptions.text: Should amounts be written the way customers see them (12.50) or in minor units as stored (1250)?
readings: Decimal amounts with a separate currency column.
assumptions.answer: Decimal amounts with a currency column, because the file is meant to be opened in Excel by finance.

assumptions.text: For very large lists, must the file download straight away, or can it be emailed when ready?
readings: Download in the same request, whatever the size.
Generate large exports in the background and email a link.
assumptions.answer: Download in the same request; nothing in the ticket suggests lists large enough to need a background job.
